SA-51
SUSPENSION ANO AXLE ,.. FRONT STABILIZER BAR
REMOVAL
1. REMOVE STABILIZER BAR LINKS
(a) Remove the 2 nuts and stabilizer bar link.
Torque: 44 N-m (449 kgf-cm, 32 ft.fbf)
HINT:
If the ball joint turns together with the nut, use a hexagon (5 mm)
wrench to hold the stud.
(b) Employ the same manner described above to the other
N side.
2. REMOVE FRONT SUSPENSION MEMBER WITH LOW¥
ER SUSPENSION ARM (See page SA-42)
3. REMOVE STABILIZER BAR Cut out
{a) Remove the 2 bolls, bracket and bushing.
Torque: 19 N.m (194 kgf.cm, 14 tt-lbf)
HINT:
At the time of installation, please refer to the following items.
Install the bushing so that the cutout will face to the rear.
Install the bushing to the outside of the paint line on the
stabilizer bar.
N FG8658 (b) Employ the same manner described above to the other
side.
(c) Remove the stabilizer bar.
